engines.name: Jobs
engines.description: Monosage's own job search: open roles from free, public job-board APIs (Himalayas, The Muse, Remotive, Jobicy, Arbeitnow), searched by Monosage itself. No SerpApi key and no credits. Results use the Google Jobs shape (jobs_results with title, company_name, location, via, description, apply_options), so Careers, the Jobs tab and alerts work on them unchanged. Every result credits its board and links back to it.

pagination.notes: One page of up to num results, newest first. Each board is cached on Monosage's side to respect its terms, so repeating a search within hours costs the boards nothing.

engines.aira_use: Find open roles without a SerpApi key: the free source behind the Jobs page, Careers without a key and Auto-apply plans.

params.name: q
params.label: Search query
params.help: The role to look for, e.g. 'cloud architect'. Every key word must appear in the job title.

params.name: location
params.label: Location
params.help: A city ('Austin, TX'), a country ('Germany') or 'Remote'. Remote jobs open to that country also match.

params.name: country
params.label: Country code
params.help: Two-letter country such as US or DE. Worked out from location when left empty.

params.name: remote_only
params.label: Remote only
params.help: Only jobs that can be done from home.

params.name: employment_type
params.label: Employment type
params.help: Keep only one kind of employment when the board says which.

params.name: boards
params.label: Boards
params.help: Which boards to search; all of them when empty.

params.name: num
params.label: Results
params.help: Most results to return (1 to 100, default 40).
